Urgent Report! Eastern First Branch received a letter today, its contents nothing short of extraordinary...
The sender, one Ren Chang'an, claims to have wandered a desert in his dreams last night, where he encountered a snow-bearded general clad in gilded armor. The general spoke of Frostbite, an ancient remedy used by frontier commanders to ward off heatstroke.
Though the dream faded upon waking, one phrase lingered: "Drink it under the noon sun, and chill shall pierce your veins, repelling all summer's fury!"
Its truth remains unverified. Yet, with two taels of Frostbite still in hand, I tested the method described—indeed, a wave of coolness swept over me, banishing the heat entirely!
Thus, Eastern First Branch proclaims to the realm: We summon the Mysterious Man to East Wind Pavilion to collaborate on Frostbite, for the salvation of all!
